blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ اْلاَنْصَارِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ لَايَلْقَي اللهَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ بِهَا إِلَّا حَجَبَتْهُ عَنِ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: لَايَلْقَي اللهَ بِهِمَا أَحَدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلَّا أُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَي مَاكَانَ فِيهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني في الكبير والاوسط ورجاله ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:١٦٥/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Amrah Ansari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whichever servant meets Allah on the Day of Qiyamah with the testimony, “There is none worthy of worship except Allah, and I am the Messenger of Allah’, having full faith in it, this Kalimah will certainly shield him from the Fire.”

blocks.text:
In another narration it has come: “Whichever servant meets Allah on the Day of Qiyamah firmly holding these two testimonies (the oneness of Allah and the prophethood of the Prophet ﷺ) will be entered into Jannah, however many sins there may be in the record of his deeds.”
(Musnad Ahmad)

Explanation:- In the light of other ahadith, the commentators explain this hadith and ahadith like it as follows: “Whoever meets Allah having accepted the Kalimah Shahadah, that is, the oneness of Allah and the prophethood of Rasulullah ﷺ, then even if there are sins in his record, Allah, by His great grace, will certainly enter him into Jannah, either forgiving them and admitting him at once, or after giving him a punishment fitting his sins.”
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عِتْبَانَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا يَشْهَدُ أَحَدٌ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ فَيَدْخُلَ النَّارَ أَوْ تَطْعَمَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه مسلم باب الدليل علي ان من مات ... رقم:١٤٩
